name: Truth Of Scripture
overview: Scripture reveals that truth is foundational to God's nature and His revelation to humanity. The law of the LORD is described as perfect and sure, capable of restoring and imparting wisdom (Psalms 19:7), while Jesus Christ embodies truth, being the way to the Father and the source of life (John 1:14; John 14:6). Believers are set free through knowing this truth (John 8:32), which the Spirit of truth faithfully guides into all understanding (John 16:13). Ultimately, God's word itself is truth that sanctifies and transforms those who receive it (John 17:17).
